scaling: features standardized and targets z-scored with training-fold statistics only
prediction_units: raw tile signature score (back-transformed from the fold's z-scale)

p_value_method.within_patient_p: two-sided sign-flip permutation over per-patient r
p_value_method.between_patient_p: two-sided permutation of patient mean predictions across patients
p_value_method.pooled_r: no p-value: tiles are not independent; see the bootstrap CI

auc_definition: ROC-AUC separating the top third of tiles from the bottom third by true score (thresholds at the 33rd and 67th percentiles of all evaluated tiles). The middle third is excluded, so this is easier than an all-tiles AUC.
